release_notes: Bandwidth limiting now measures the link: no limit, a fixed maximum, or a percentage of the speed IDM actually moved, refreshed while downloads run.
The Download Progress window plots speed over time and shows the limit that is really binding, so a slow server is no longer mistaken for a cap.
FTP and FTPS downloads with resume, engine-level redirects up to eight hops, and dynamic re-segmentation that hands a stalled connection's tail to an idle one.
New Properties, Rename, Refresh Download Link, Verify Checksum and Add Batch Downloads tools, plus system tray control and native notifications.
Connection settings gained an HTTP/HTTPS proxy with bypass matching, per-site credentials and timeouts; passwords live in Windows Credential Manager, never in the database.
Brave and Opera are detected and registered, and the Browser Integration page now shows the native host answering live.
